category_title: Students who exhibit initial fear and avoidance but transition to engagement through curiosity and hands-on success
minimal_context: The student is participating in an out-of-school biology workshop session where they are tasked with touching and dissecting a worm.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the worm for today's activity. Please begin by touching it before we start the dissection.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looking at the worm, appearing scared) Have you opened up a worm before? You’re a scientist.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yes, I have. What do you think you should do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to grow up to be a scientist.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, then please go ahead and touch the worm.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Ok, I’m going to touch it. One, two, three. (Touches the worm and then screams)
